tools.name: sagesales_list_accounts
tools.description: List the accounts (companies or people you sell to). Sage Sales Management API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: sagesales_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts linked to accounts. Sage Sales Management API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: sagesales_list_opportunities
tools.description: List the sales opportunities. Sage Sales Management API: GET /opportunities.

tools.name: sagesales_list_activities
tools.description: List the logged activities (visits, calls, notes). Sage Sales Management API: GET /activities.

tools.name: sagesales_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List the sales order headers (proposals drawn up for accounts). Sage Sales Management API: GET /salesorders.

tools.name: sagesales_list_products
tools.description: List the products in the catalog. Sage Sales Management API: GET /products.

tools.name: sagesales_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by id. Sage Sales Management API: GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: sagesales_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. Sage Sales Management API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: sagesales_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id. Sage Sales Management API: GET /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: sagesales_create_account
tools.description: Create a new account. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /accounts.

tools.name: sagesales_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact, optionally linked to an account by accountId. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: sagesales_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a new sales opportunity for an account. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /opportunities.

tools.name: sagesales_update_opportunity
tools.description: Change the value, chance of winning or comment of one opportunity. Only the fields you set are sent. Sage Sales Management API: PUT /opportunities/{id}.
